name: Chip
description: A compact tag with an optional icon or avatar that can be removed or toggled.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before the label, sized to 14 pixels.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A 20 pixel avatar before the label: an image URL (initials if it fails), or your own element.

props.name: tone
props.description: The soft tint, as on Badge. A selected chip is always water.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a round remove button. The chip shrinks and fades, then this is called; remove it from your list here.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the remove button. Defaults to "Remove {label}".

props.name: selected
props.description: Makes the chip a toggle (controlled). Selected chips turn water-tinted and a check draws in.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims the chip and disables its buttons.
